purpose: First recording batch for the seven instruments professional Chinese orchestra users are most likely to reject if the timbre is fake.

global_delivery_rules.accepted_source_format: wav or aiff, 44.1 kHz or 48 kHz, 24-bit preferred, no reverb, no EQ, no compression
global_delivery_rules.composition_rights: Use single notes, scales, idiomatic gestures, or original improvisation only. Do not record copyrighted melodies unless a separate composition license is attached.

items.priority_reason: Bowed huqin timbre, slides, vibrato, and bow attack are immediately recognizable to professional users.

take_specs.content: open string or sustained tone with natural bow attack
short expressive slide without copyrighted melody
original two- to four-bar idiomatic phrase

reject_if: background accompaniment or backing track is present

items.priority_reason: Must sound brighter and higher than erhu; users will notice if it is only a pitch-shifted erhu.

take_specs.content: bright sustained tone showing high-register color
short Cantonese-style ornament, original and non-copyrighted
original quick lyrical phrase

reject_if: background accompaniment or backing track is present

items.priority_reason: Must provide the lower alto huqin color, not merely a slowed or EQ'd erhu.

take_specs.content: lower sustained tone with natural bow resonance
lyrical original phrase in lower register
short gesture showing bow change or string crossing

reject_if: background accompaniment or backing track is present

items.priority_reason: Low bowed gehu is easy to misrepresent as cello, zhonghu, or synthesized bass.

take_specs.content: low sustained bowed tone with natural body resonance
short bass gesture, no copyrighted melody
clear bow attack and decay in lower register

reject_if: western cello only with no gehu identity
background accompaniment or backing track is present

items.priority_reason: Free-reed chord breath, pipe response, and inhale/exhale continuity cannot be faked convincingly.

take_specs.content: long chord with natural reed beating and breath
single pipe tone or simple interval
short arpeggio or chordal gesture

reject_if: sounds like harmonica or accordion preset
background accompaniment or backing track is present

items.priority_reason: Suona reed pressure, piercing attack, and ornamentation are impossible to hide from professional listeners.

take_specs.content: sustained tone with natural reed pressure
short original ornament, no copyrighted melody
strong attack and decay

reject_if: sounds like trumpet, oboe, or synth lead
background accompaniment or backing track is present

items.priority_reason: Banhu must have a bright northern huqin attack and cannot be a renamed erhu.

take_specs.content: bright attack and short sustain
sustained tone showing wooden-board/coconut-shell resonance
original northern-style short phrase

reject_if: background accompaniment or backing track is present
